title: Cmd Launched with Hidden Start Flags to Suspicious Targets - Generic
description:
Detects cmd.exe executing commands with the "start" utility using "/b" (no window) or "/min" (minimized) flags.
To reduce false positives from standard background tasks, detection is restricted to scenarios where the target is a known script extension or located in suspicious temporary/public directories.
This technique was observed in Chaos, DarkSide, and Emotet malware campaigns.
sigma: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%start %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%start/b%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%start/min%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-b %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/b %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–b %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—b %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―b %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-b"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/b"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–b"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—b"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―b"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-min"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/min"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–min"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—min"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―min"%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Documents\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\inetpub\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Music\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Photos\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Videos\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.scr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE
